Poor service, look elsewhere
Feb 2019 • Couples
Having read the positive reviews we visited fro dinner. The upper floor was full we were told and initially were sent to the dungeon type dinning room and them moved to a room which faced the entrance.It had one large table in it with seating for 8 people.
The staff struggled with any sort of English and eventually someone was called to help with our order. Most of the seafood on the menu (which is in English) lobster, prawn and crab is sold by weight. 
With lobster being sold at VND 4,000,000 a kilo and obviously you pay for a whole lobster and they are at least one kilo each. 
The prawns we eventually were able to find out were sold at an initial 350gms.
After placing the order we were basically abandoned in this room. 
The prawns we had were actually quite good and fresh but really the service of this place certainly distorted our impression especially with the excellent hospitality we have had since we arrived in Hanoi.
Looking at some of the clients entering and leaving I do wonder whether this caters more for the local affluent residents and they really don't need to pay much attention to the odd visiting tourist.
Its very expensive and service poor, my advice would be look elsewhere there is an abundance of restaurants of all price ranges in the area. This is the fist time I've left a poor review rating!

Lunch at Ocean House
Dec 2018 • Family
We decided to try Ocean House for a seafood lunch. We climbed a flight of steps and entered a lovely old building. The staff took us down another flight of stairs and we had a lovely room to ourselves, a semi-basement with a nice garden view. The menu is focused on seafood, we decided to try fried prawns with tamarind sauce. We ordered a plate of mixed stir fried vegetables and steamed rice to accompany this plus excellent white wine by the glass. The prawns were excellent and both the rice and vegetables were good. We finished off with a scoop of mango sorbet. An excellent lunch & we will return when next in Ha Noi.

Beautiful food, wonderful setting
Mar 2018 • Couples
We decided to head to Ocean house after a terrible customer service experience at another seafood restaurant around the corner. Ocean house is set inside a beautiful old house with multiple levels. The prices are not cheap here but the food and service is extraordinary. We had the lobster which was big enough to cook to 2 separate ways. First was fried in butter and garlic which was so good, the second was cheese, french cream and onion severed on toasted bread which was so delicious.
If i had more time in Hanoi i would definitely be returning and people who complain about the price either don't understand the per kg pricing or really can't afford what they've asked for

Average price: $50/ person including wine

Far away from the appearance, the menu and service are not so special and almost everything in the menu can be consumed at a much cheaper price in normal seafood house. Although the cooking style seems simple, this restaurant knows how to cook seafood so well! I have never tasted such tender, juicy squid in my life! 

The staff cannot communicate in English. When I was ordering, she was even on her phone texting someone and didn't look at us once. We asked for her recommendation, she located a dish on the Vietnamese version of the menu and then find the exact row of the dish in English version to show us. She has some hearing problems too, kept missing our orders twice so we had to eat appetizer dish at the end of the meal...

One of the best places in Hanoi for fine dining
Nov 2016 • Family
We had our dinners here twice and both were fantastic. One time, four people sitting in the basement room, very quiet and private. We ate soft-shells turtles stewed, lobsters salad and raw Australian oysters which were perfect. The other time, we sat with our friends for a pre-wedding party. It was amazing how 40 people were able to fit there on the third floor room almost perfectly. We were happy with the food and drinks they selected for us. For the second time, grilled lobsters in cheese was very nice. The manager was very friendly and helpful. This Christmas we'll come back. It's recommended for those who seek for elegant places in Hanoi.

Perfect service, fine food
Nov 2015 • Friends
We visited here recently with some new friends and their children. They ordered ahead so there was little waiting for food once the group assembled. Everything was superb-- wonderful flavors, exquisite presentation, and unobtrusive service. The staff easily accommodated the needs of the youngest of the group, a five year old, and adroitly kept places clean and the food moving between serving plates and ours so that the conversation was not disturbed. We had a caviar salad, wonderful sea snails, crab soup, and the sea bass which were all pleasant and delicious. We'd jump at the chance to come back here, particularly if we wanted to talk undisturbed-- the private dining areas really were conducive to this aspect of a pleasant meal.
